meta.title: Endrika azonao ampiasaina · ONIR CMS
meta.description: Alaivo ny modely hita maso ONIR CMS: Immersive, Starter, MandamPro, Nuit & Jade ary Atelier Paper. Malalaka, vonona ampidirina.
meta.ogDescription: Alaivo ny modely hita maso ONIR CMS.

hero.title: Endrika azonao ampiasaina
hero.lead: Azonao atao ny manovanova ny endrikin'ny assistant IA araka izay endriny tianao, azonao atao ihany koa ny mampamorona endriny vaovao
hero.freeNote: Malalaka avokoa ny endrika rehetra ankehitriny.

items.name: Immersive
items.description: Sehatra 3D feno: trano fidirana, efitrano, avatar, album, resaka tari-dalana ary fampidirana rakitra.
items.detailsText: Modely ofisialy misy assets CC0. Sehatra 3D, avatar TalkingHead, album, fahalalana, media, fandrindrana rohy ary rakitra (CV, antontan-taratasy).
items.author: Rinoheinrich

items.name: Starter
items.description: Ny modely fototra: taratasy fanamarinana, resaka ary media.
items.detailsText: Ny fiandohana kely indrindra hahatakarana ny fifanarahana mpampiantrano sy hamoronana ny modely hita maso anao.
items.author: Rinoheinrich

items.name: MandamPro
items.description: Resaka ho an’ny besinimaro misy endrika ChatGPT: taratasy, hafatra, fikarohana fiche ary media.
items.detailsText: Modely ho an’ny besinimaro MandamPro, UI-only, maneho blocs fikarohana, media ary saha voafaritra.
items.author: Rinoheinrich

items.name: Nuit & Jade
items.author: Anjary
items.description: Resaka tsara tarehy miloko alina, jade sy cobalt: karatra boribory, avatar ary sehatra pejy + widget.
items.detailsText: Modely ONIR CMS noforonin’i Anjary. Charte Man-Dam Pro: alina, jade sy cobalt, karatra fotsy, bokotra pill, avatar ary fampisehoana hafatra, media sy valin’ny fikarohana.

items.name: Atelier Paper
items.author: Anjary
items.description: Modely taratasy mainty sy fotsy, misy encoches sy soratra monospace, ho an’ny resaka editorial tsotra.
items.detailsText: Modely ONIR CMS noforonin’i Anjary. Design « Spin Product »: karatra fotsy misy encoches, accent mainty, soratra monospace, sehatra pejy sy widget.
